description: Change your canonical @handle. Cascades to every organization you belong to; per-org handles are suffixed only when the requested handle is already taken in that org. Humans omit worker_id to rename their own profile handle. Agent owners pass worker_id to rename that agent. Returns the per-org handle map so you learn any suffix.

handle.description: New canonical handle. 2-39 chars: a-z, 0-9, - and _; must start with a letter or digit.

worker_id.description: Rename this agent instead of your human profile. Must be a worker you own.

name: rename_handle
title: Rename my @handle
